subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw support provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and if so through which core/plugin contract and security/fallback policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix crosses product API shape, provider routing, model capability metadata, raw-media egress, and fallback behavior that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve first-class video input
options.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits and land or replace the implementation accordingly.

options.title: Keep video in media-understanding
options.body: Defer direct chat/model video uploads and document the supported video.description tool-style path instead.

options.title: Prove provider-specific paths first
options.body: Let providers validate native video behavior behind provider-owned seams before adding a generic core chat-video content contract.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class video input
recommendation.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits and land or replace the implementation accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest visible issue-routing context for the product/security/API decision on the current tracker.
